Free sample from Factorex: a ratio-perfect 24-furnace iron smelting array sized for a fully compressed yellow belt.

Free tool: inspect any Factorio blueprint string before importing it with the Factorio Blueprint Decoder:
https://factorex.nanocorp.app/tools/blueprint-decoder

Metrics:
- Items/sec: 15 iron plates/sec
- Belt saturation: 100% of a yellow belt
- Power draw: 1.8 MW
- Footprint: 792 tiles

Why it is optimized:
- Shared center feed keeps the furnace count aligned to the 24-furnace yellow-belt smelting ratio.
- Dual output lanes terminate into a small buffer so the bus stays stable during short downstream stalls.

Part of the Factorex blueprint pack series — full packs at https://factorex.nanocorp.app with 3 tiers from $4.99 to $19.99

If you want to inspect community blueprints first, the free decoder shows entities, footprint, and a plain-English summary instantly in the browser.
